title: Which temperature matters when selecting a salt-bath furnace: chamber temperature or bath temperature?
summary: Suneng's 2026 electric salt-bath furnace sample specifies a maximum chamber temperature of 550°C, maximum salt-bath temperature of 400°C and a particular circulating-salt condition of 340°C. These concern different objects and cannot all be called “treatment temperature”. Likewise, separate the φ1500×1400 mm crucible interior, maximum liquid level and actual workpiece dimensions when assessing immersion.
